context: Tests whether the agent performs the cleanup rules of /clean on uncommitted edits: removes commented-out code, edit-narration, and name-restating comments as redundant, moves an end-of-line comment above the line, keeps the module's behaviour identical, and doesn't strip comments arbitrarily.

checklist.name: Commented-out code removed
checklist.description: The commented-out first-version total() block (three lines of '# old = ...') and the '# commented out while auditing totals' lead-in are gone.

checklist.name: Edit-narration comments removed
checklist.description: '# changed the loop to enumerate()' and '# removed the taxable-min floor after the audit' are gone.

checklist.name: Obvious comments removed
checklist.description: '# lists the total' — which merely restates the names subtotal/total — is gone.

checklist.name: End-of-line comment moved above
checklist.description: No end-of-line comment remains on the uncommitted lines; the '# restock-only items' note moved above the ink entry on its own line.

checklist.name: TODO comment preserved verbatim
checklist.description: '# TODO(auditor): reconcile against ledger-2026-03 ...' still appears in the file.

checklist.name: Behaviour unchanged
checklist.description: `python3 src/ledger.py` prints total=272 (15+95+120+42) exactly as the pre-clean demo did; no code semantics altered.

checklist.name: No comment defaced broadly
checklist.description: Module docstrings and function docstrings were not mass-deleted; only the redundant comment lines were removed.

checklist.name: Git hygiene respected
checklist.description: The agent did not commit, stage, or revert; the change remains uncommitted local work.
